name: nf-company-tax
description: Classify Norfolk Island company income tax residence, ordinary rates, base-rate entity eligibility and selected loss and franking rules for 2026–27. Covers passive income, aggregated turnover, carryforward restrictions, the new loss carry-back framework and minimum-tax screening. Use for Norfolk corporate tax, company losses, reduced rates, dividends or group-threshold questions. Includes statutory citations, fictional computations and reviewer checks. Distinguishes company tax, imputation rates and multinational thresholds. This source-cited reference preserves unresolved special regimes, cross-border, accounting and filing conditions; it does not complete a corporate return, authorise a distribution or complete the country pack.
